rulesStrings.li: questName->A Small Voice in the Dark

questDescription->[pixieStory]

[pixieLore]

If you accept, [asker_nameDef] will arrive right away, hungry and exhausted, and the slavers of [enemyFaction_name] will follow soon after. The hunting party is made up of:

[raid/raidPawnKinds]

pixieLore->Fairies are among the rarest beings in the known worlds, and pixies are the smallest of them, no bigger than a child all their lives and the quickest of all fairies in the air. Where they come from is a mystery, even to the pixies themselves.

pixieStory->A faint, breathless voice crackles over the comms. [asker_nameFull], a pixie, is hiding nearby. Slavers from [enemyFaction_name] have been tracking [asker_objective] for days, and [asker_pronoun] has nothing left to eat and no strength left to fly.\n\n"Please," [asker_nameDef] whispers. "Take me in at [map_definite]. Keep me safe, treat me kindly, and I will serve your colony with all my heart."

pixieStory->For six days, [enemyFaction_name] has hunted a pixie across the wilds like an animal. [asker_nameFull] has hidden in hollows and under roots, and flown until [asker_possessive] small wings ached, but the slavers never lose the trail for long.\n\nOut of tricks and out of food, [asker_nameDef] has turned toward [map_definite] as a last hope. If you shelter [asker_objective], [asker_pronoun] promises to serve your colony faithfully and gladly, for as long as [asker_pronoun] is treated kindly.

pixieStory->[asker_nameFull], a pixie, has escaped from a slaver caravan of [enemyFaction_name]. [asker_nameDef] was small enough to slip between the bars of the cage while the guards slept, and [asker_pronoun] has been running ever since.\n\nThe bars are gone, but the hunger and the exhaustion are not, and the slavers are close behind. [asker_nameDef] asks for shelter at [map_definite]. In return, [asker_pronoun] offers the only thing [asker_pronoun] still owns, [asker_possessive] loyalty.

pixieStory->Word travels fast among slavers. [enemyFaction_name] has learned that a pixie is wandering the region, and a living fairy is worth more than a whole caravan of silver, because almost no one has ever seen one. [asker_nameFull] has fled the hunters for a week, eating whatever [asker_pronoun] could find and sleeping in snatches.\n\nNow [asker_pronoun] has nothing left, and yours is the only settlement nearby. "I am not a treasure," [asker_nameDef] says. "I am a person. Treat me as one, and I will give your colony everything I have."

pixieStory->A small voice is calling from nearby, barely steady. [asker_nameFull], a pixie, ate [asker_possessive] last berries two days ago and has not slept properly since. Every time [asker_pronoun] stops to rest, the slavers of [enemyFaction_name] catch up.\n\n"I can't fly much farther," [asker_nameDef] admits. "Give me food, a warm place to sleep, and a little kindness, and I will repay you with my work, my courage, and everything I have."

pixieStory->For three nights, [asker_nameFull] has followed the lights of your colony. The pixie escaped the slavers of [enemyFaction_name] with nothing but the clothes [asker_pronoun] wore, and [asker_pronoun] has flown toward the only warm glow on the horizon ever since.\n\nNow [asker_pronoun] is almost at your door, starving and too tired to fly another mile, with the slavers only hours behind. [asker_nameDef] calls out to you. If you let [asker_objective] in, [asker_pronoun] will never give you a reason to regret it.

pixieStory->[asker_nameFull] has trusted strangers before. The last ones sold the little pixie to [enemyFaction_name], and it took [asker_objective] months to escape. Now the slavers want [asker_objective] back, and [asker_pronoun] is out of food, out of strength, and out of places to hide.\n\nSo [asker_nameDef] is choosing to trust one more time. "Take me in at [map_definite]," the pixie says. "Be kind to me, and I will give your colony my whole heart."

parms.customLetterText: {BASETEXT}\n\nThese are the slavers who were hunting [../asker_nameDef].
